comment: Annotations follow the model context and Table S3: RAS family species expanded to HRAS/KRAS/NRAS; MEK/ERK expanded to MAP2K/MAPK isoforms; SOS expanded to SOS1/SOS2. Ligand-bound forms (Ras_GTP/Ras_GDP, EGFR·EGF, inhibited RAF) are modeled as physical complexes: each complex lists its protein and small-molecule components (GTP/GDP, EGF, sorafenib) and distinct protein partners. Phosphorylated forms and negative-feedback phosphorylated species are represented by the base protein names (phospho label omitted) per instructions. Where the model indicates inhibited RAF (iRaf1/iBRaf/nfpi*), these are represented as RAF1/BRAF plus sorafenib components.
